branding.name: Branding
branding.heroAlt: Brand guidelines, paper stocks and typography samples laid across a studio table.
branding.headline: A brand that finally matches the business behind it.
branding.offer: A six-to-eight-week, end-to-end brand build — complete strategy, creative direction, and a visual identity system — designed to launch your brand with clarity, confidence, and a luxury presence.

shift.heading: The shift
shift.body: Businesses of real quality are rarely broken — they're scattered, their best work spread across parts that were never designed to work together. We don't decorate; we clarify. We begin at the core — what your business is, what it believes, and why it matters — and let everything visible grow from there. You leave with one coherent system instead of disconnected parts, and the confidence to stop apologising for how you look.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.summary: A clear, confident core for a business finding its feet.
scope: Visual identity — primary logo & core system

tiers.name: Signature
tiers.summary: The full end-to-end brand build — strategy to identity.
scope: Full visual identity — logo suite, colour & type

tiers.name: Bespoke
tiers.summary: A landmark brand, crafted without limits.

process.title: Immersion
process.body: We start beneath the surface — understanding the business, its audience, and the truth it's built on. Strategy before anything visible.

process.title: Strategy
process.body: The foundation is set: positioning, messaging, and voice — the thinking every visible decision will grow from.

process.title: Creative direction
process.body: The world takes shape. Art direction and visual language, explored and agreed before a single asset is finalised.

process.title: Identity system
process.body: The complete system — logo suite, typography, colour, and the guidelines that keep it coherent everywhere it appears.

process.title: Launch
process.body: A considered rollout plan and a full handover, so the brand arrives with intention rather than noise.

faqs.q: Can I customise or mix the packages?
faqs.a: Yes. The tiers are starting points — we shape the exact scope together in our first conversation, so you only pay for what your brand genuinely needs.
A 50% deposit secures your start date; the balance is due before launch. For larger projects we can split it further.
A full Signature build usually runs six to eight weeks, depending on scope and how quickly feedback comes back.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to begin?
faqs.a: An introduction to your business, your goals, and any existing materials. We guide every step from there.
You receive every file and the brand guidelines, plus a walkthrough. Bespoke adds ongoing post-launch support.

websites.name: Websites
websites.heroAlt: A wall of pinned editorial layouts and case-study pages in the noova studio.
websites.headline: A website as considered as the brand behind it.
websites.offer: A refined four-to-eight-week digital build that transforms your brand into an elevated, seamless website — crafted with intentional design, strategic structure, and a world-class user experience.

shift.heading: The shift
shift.body: Most websites quietly undersell the business behind them — busy where they should be clear, decorative where they should be structural. We design the opposite: a calm, editorial experience that guides the right people through a single, deliberate story. Fast, considered, and unmistakably yours — a home that finally carries the brand instead of diminishing it.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.summary: A refined, compact site that reads beautifully.

tiers.name: Signature
tiers.summary: The full editorial website, built to perform.

tiers.name: Bespoke
tiers.summary: A larger, tailored build with room to grow.

process.title: Discovery
process.body: Goals, audience, and content, understood first. We agree what the website has to achieve before we design a single screen.

process.title: Strategy & structure
process.body: Sitemap, information architecture, and content hierarchy — the quiet skeleton that makes the whole experience feel effortless.

process.title: Design
process.body: Editorial, brand-aligned page design. One idea leads each screen, never several competing for the eye.

process.title: Build
process.body: Development, integrations, SEO foundations, and performance — engineered to be fast, accessible, and easy to run.

process.title: Launch & support
process.body: Careful QA, a smooth launch, and aftercare — plus a walkthrough so you're never left guessing how it works.

faqs.q: Which platform do you build on?
faqs.a: Primarily Webflow — fast, reliable, and easy for you to edit. Other platforms are available on request.

faqs.q: Can I update the site myself afterwards?
faqs.a: Yes. Signature and above include a CMS and a walkthrough, so you can add posts and edit content without a developer.
A 50% deposit books your slot; the balance is due before launch.

faqs.q: How long does a website take?
faqs.a: Between four and eight weeks, depending on the tier and how ready your content is.
One to two weeks of aftercare is included, and an optional maintenance retainer is available.

marketing.name: Marketing & Growth
marketing.heroAlt: Overhead view of noova journal pages being laid out and edited across a desk.
marketing.headline: A presence worth returning to.
marketing.offer: An ongoing marketing partnership that turns your brand into a living publication — uniting editorial content, considered campaigns, and intelligent systems into one coherent presence, designed to reach the right people, build lasting trust, and grow with intention rather than noise.

shift.heading: The shift
shift.body: Most marketing is made to fill a schedule — louder, faster, forgotten by morning. We build the opposite: a body of work worth returning to. Every channel becomes one edition of the same publication, carrying a single voice and level of care. Presence over frequency, meaning over volume — a brand that speaks when it has something worth saying, and grows because of it.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.summary: A steady, considered presence on one channel.

tiers.name: Signature
tiers.summary: The publication, plus campaigns that land.

tiers.name: Bespoke
tiers.summary: A full growth partnership with systems behind it.

process.title: Foundation
process.body: We audit where you stand — voice, channels, and measurement — and define the themes the work will keep returning to.

process.title: The publication
process.body: A content strategy and editorial calendar noova can hold for years, not weeks — the same voice across every channel.

process.title: Campaigns
process.body: Considered launches, concepts, and collaborations — moments of intent rather than a constant, anxious stream.

process.title: Systems
process.body: The intelligent layer beneath it all — automation, CRM, and analytics that turn attention into relationships.

process.title: Rhythm
process.body: An ongoing partnership: publishing, reviewing, and refining — compounding presence and trust over time.

faqs.a: We ask for an initial three months, so the work has room to compound rather than being judged on a single post.
A simple monthly retainer, billed at the start of each month. You can move up or down a tier with a month's notice.
No — media budget is separate and paid directly to the platforms. We manage the campaigns; you keep control of the spend.
Whatever fits your audience — most often Instagram and LinkedIn, plus email and your journal. We focus rather than spread thin.

faqs.q: What do you need from me?
faqs.a: Access to your channels and a short monthly check-in. We handle strategy, creation, and reporting.

automation.name: AI & Automation
automation.heroAlt: An analytics dashboard on a tablet beside brand materials on a dark studio surface.
automation.headline: The intelligent systems behind the brand.
automation.offer: A build of the automations, funnels and AI workflows that let an ambitious business grow without adding headcount — lead generation, CRM, email and operations, connected into one quiet, reliable system.

shift.heading: The shift
shift.body: Growth usually means more work — more manual follow-up, more spreadsheets, more things slipping through. It doesn't have to. The right systems do the repetitive work in the background: capturing leads, nurturing them, updating your CRM, and freeing you for the work only you can do. Not more tools bolted on — one connected system, built around how your business actually runs.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.summary: One automation or lead funnel, built end to end.
scope: A single automation or lead-gen funnel

tiers.name: Signature
scope: Lead-gen funnel + landing page or quiz

process.title: Map
process.body: We map how your business actually runs — the leads, the follow-ups, the handoffs — and find where time leaks.

process.title: Design
process.body: We design the system — the funnel, the flows, the data, the tools — on paper before anything is built.

process.title: Build
process.body: We build and connect it — automations, CRM, email, AI workflows — as one reliable system.

process.title: Test
process.body: We test every path, document it in plain language, and hand it over so you understand exactly how it runs.

process.title: Optimise
process.body: We watch the numbers and refine — tightening what converts, removing what doesn't.

faqs.q: Which tools do you build with?
faqs.a: Whatever fits — Make, Zapier, ManyChat, plus your CRM and email tool. We work with what you have, or recommend the simplest stack.
No. We build it, document it in plain language, and walk you through it. You run it; we're here if it needs to change.
Simple systems are a fixed project fee; larger, evolving ones can run as a monthly partnership. We agree the scope up front.

faqs.q: Will it work with my website and brand?
faqs.a: Yes — that's the point. We build the systems to fit the brand, not the other way around, so everything stays coherent.
We use reputable, secure platforms and give you full ownership and access. Nothing is locked to us.
